## 2.3) Claims Review — final verification before insurer submission

Human-in-the-loop gate for workers comp / CTP claims. 2.2) Invoice validates claims and stages them in the ledger as pending_review — nothing is emailed to an insurer until it is approved here.

GET /claims-review serves the review dashboard (claim details, destination insurer email, sessions remaining, warnings). Approve & send emails the tax invoice to the insurer, marks the claim submitted and counts up sessions_used on the funding profile. Reject records the reason in the ledger.

Publish this workflow to activate the production URL: <your-instance>/webhook/claims-review

## Decision handling

The dashboard posts JSON to the same path: { action: approve | reject | approve_all, claim_reference, reason }. Claims with no active funding profile or no insurer email cannot be approved (approve_all skips them). Patients left with 2 or fewer approved sessions after sending trigger the AHTR renewal alert email.
